notes: Easy single-competency task: author a Makefile driving gfortran over a .f90 module and a main program (module compiled before the program that USEs it), link both objects into /app/avalanche_report, and confirm the tool's documented output on the visible and two hidden station-data files. The main failure modes are the module-not-compiled-before-program ordering (build breaks on the missing .mod) and a build that never produces/links the executable; both are caught by the forced make -B rebuild plus execution checks.
